name: orchestrator
description: Standalone fleet orchestrator. Talks to the AgentHydra daemon over HTTP; owns no state of its own.

scripts.test:reference-note: echo the TS under src/ and tests/ is non-running reference material lifted from AgentHydra - see README
scripts.//remote: THE REMOTE FRONT-END (web/ + server/): a Bun+Hono gateway that serves the Vue dashboard, gates it behind Sign in with Connections, and opens a Cloudflare tunnel - RepoYeti's remote-access stack, vendored. The Python toolbox stays stdlib-only; this is the one TypeScript surface, because the auth stack lives there.
scripts.remote:typecheck: bun run --cwd web typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck
